Priya Nair: Passing CogniaHealth to CS. Signed POC for 60 days, kickoff 2025-04-14. Quick snapshot: ~90k tokens/week, ~8k embeddings, two production routes (clinical-notes, search).

Priya Nair: Current stack: hosted API, OAuth SSO via Okta in progress (SAML assertions expected next week). Customer classifies data as PHI; expecting a private deployment ask before renewal. Renewal window ~8 months out; flagging ~60% churn risk if latency or compliance gaps persist.

Priya Nair: Main asks from customer during sales:
- low-latency for summarization flows (~<300ms p50)
- audit logs + KMS integration for keys
- pricing cap for embeddings bulk-run jobs

Priya Nair: Hand-off notes (short):
```
CS owner: Mira Patel (primary)
Support ticket: SUP-4999 (Ethan)
Eng owner: Ravi Shah (model selection & infra)
Sales docs: SF link internal: https://salesforce.company/opp/Cognia-77
Artifacts: sample long prompt set + embedding batch CSV attached in SF
Priority: get telemetry window and quick bench on M-Gen-7B and M-Embed-3B
```

Mira Patel: Thanks Priya 30 taking over CS lead. I'll arrange kickoff + technical walkthrough. Can you confirm who in their team will own telemetry access?

Priya Nair: Point of contact: anita@cogniahealth.com (Head of Data Eng) and luke@cogniahealth.com (DevOps). Priya: they said they'd enable a 48hr read-only telemetry snapshot after kickoff.

Ethan Cole: Creating SUP-4999 now to track latency and telemetry. Need: request for read-only metrics export, example prompts, and a brief list of peak hours. I'll attach initial SUP stub into SF opp.

Ravi Shah: I'll look at model routing and quantization options. If PHI is required, we should prep a Private/VPC feasibility note and a security checklist (KMS, audit logs). Also suggest trying 8k-context variant and enabling KV caching for summarization to reduce tokens.

OnboardBot: Reminder: onboarding checklist assigned to Mira Patel. Due in 7 business days.

Mira Patel: Kicked off calendar invite for 2025-04-14 09:30 PT with Cognia leads. Creating a shared onboarding doc for capture: integration steps, eval prompt set, cost sensitivity, and renewal watch items.

Priya Nair: Customer comment: "We need predictable token costs for large nightly embedding jobs." They prefer batching & flat-rate options if available. Also asked about SLAs for Dedicated.

Ethan Cole: Support actions: request telemetry window, enable traces for p99 path, and run initial reproduce with provided prompt set. Will link SUP-4999 to the shared doc once traces are uploaded.

Ravi Shah: I'll bench M-Gen-7B vs M-Gen-13B for their long-context summarization prompt. Plan: test with batch sizes 1,4,8 and KV cache ON/OFF. Will post results to doc by 2025-04-16.

Mira Patel: I'll add survey questions to capture developer integration pain and ask about expected QPS and cost sensitivity. Also will capture any legal/compliance timelines for Private deploy requests.

Priya Nair: Noted. I'll add billing owner contact in SF and flag renewal risk column (60%). If we reduce latency and confirm KMS+audit path, this could flip to expansion.

Ethan Cole: SUP-4999 created. Assigned to Ethan Cole and Ravi Shah. ETA for first triage: 48 hours after telemetry access.

Mira Patel: Added owners and action items in the shared doc. Will post a short summary back here after kickoff and after SUP-4999 receives traces. :thumbsup:

Priya Nair: Thanks team 3 Ill follow up with Cognia to enable telemetry and confirm SSO timeline. Leaving handoff to CS & Support.

Ravi Shah: I'll start the bench jobs on our test infra once I have the prompt set. Posting updates to the doc.

OnboardBot: Kickoff event created and reminders scheduled.

Mira Patel: Closing loop for now. Will update this thread after the kickoff meeting.
